definitions.explanation: A sense of one's own dignity or rank, especially when it makes a person hold themselves above others. Nearly always used with the adjective for "high", which is mildly critical.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気位|きぐらい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
{気位|きぐらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧だ。

⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主人|しゅじん}→主人：00987_shujin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気位|きぐらい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧にしなかった。
examples.english: The owner of the old shop was proud and would not deal with customers who came without an introduction.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気位|きぐらい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: proud, haughty
- {気位|きぐらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a proud, haughty person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦プライド→プライド：22290_puraido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: proud — the everyday phrase, not always critical
- ⟦{自尊心|じそんしん}→自尊心：11076_jisonshin⟧: self-respect — neutral or positive
- ⟦{高慢|こうまん}→高慢：19519_kouman⟧: arrogant — stronger and openly negative
